title: Elite: Dissonance Trial: Threshold Sign
description: Dissonance Trial unfolds across dissonance gallery where false harmonies break battle line timing, pushing a one active Empyrean Titan to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Dissonance Trial: Threshold Sign advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
